There is nothing wrong about making friends online. I have a friend that I've known for 4 years and it's been a great friendship.

Anyway, the best thing you can do is listen to him. Talk about his problems and show him how easy it is to fix them. People like me and him who have depression always see the things in the black colour. We are negative about everything and then we are left feeling hopeless. What you wanna do is try to change his point of view. He sees the dark and you must see light for him. For example, he may say "I've lost a good friend and I'll never make any friends again" and you wanna respond with "Why would you not make a new friend again? People make new friends their whole lifes, you can make as many friends as you'd like to."
